transcript.text: Last year I was bouncing between cities a lot—Beijing was the one where we ended up talking about what movies were even playing.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Then a couple weeks later I was in Shanghai, and everyone kept arguing about where to eat there like it was a sport.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I remember my buddy Chen Ming went to see The Wandering Earth 3 at Bona International—he was raving about the screen the whole night.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: He said the showtime was 21:50, and he just grabbed 1 seat since nobody else could make it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And for food, Li Na had already locked in Chuanfu Laozao for 2025-03-10—she planned the whole thing before we even landed.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: It was at 11:30 for 4 people, and she used her number 13877827638—so yeah, all of that was already handled back then.
